summary: 3D water-flow puzzle on the Pamukkale terraces, redesigned in pastel travertine, turquoise water with caustics and shore foam, and airy white cards, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · Pamukkale travertenlerinde 3D su akışı bulmacası, pastel traverten, kostikli turkuaz su ve beyaz kartlarla yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Water as a grid automaton: place stones, dams and splitters, start the spring and steer the flow into every pool
Still water slowly builds a white calcium rim, just like the real terraces
Redesign: pastel travertine with lit step edges, turquoise water with caustic light and shore foam, a sage meadow and ruin stones
Redesign: airy white cards with turquoise accents, floating HUD pills and a dark-mode theme; works on phones in both orientations
Measured after the redesign: 60 fps; the ?auto bot clears 20/20 levels with 46/60 stars and 0 JS errors

social.headline: Guide warm spring water into the white travertine pools · Ilık kaynak suyunu beyaz traverten havuzlarına yönlendir
